caption: The drawing depicts a partially completed cross-stitch or embroidery design on a white background. The right side shows colorful finished stitching, including a scene with three houses (pink, yellow, and green), trees with green foliage and brown trunks, a blue sky, and a field of grass in various shades of green. Above the houses, the pattern transitions to a zigzag border in red and light beige at the very top. Below the houses there is a geometric, quilt-like pattern consisting of red, yellow, blue, and pink. A few loose thread ends in blue and yellow dangle from the stitched area. The left side of the cloth features a faint, unfinished pencil or ink outline of the same scene and patterns, showing the same shapes without color or texture. The whole composition sits centered on a blank, neutral white background.
title: Beadwork on Purse (Tech. demonstration)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
